Handling of
• Red mud
• Fly Ash

Government Regulations,
Environmental & Societal
Concerns; Business
Continuity

• Construction of Red mud
expansion Pond-2
• Lean Slurry Ash disposal to
abandon mine void
• Push for fly ash utilization in brick
& cement making etc.

• Operating ESPs for boiler stacks of
CPP & Refinery and FTPs for
Smelter Potlines to control
particulate matters and fluoride
emissions.
• Retrofitting ESPs at the refinery
• Implementing on-line Fugitive
Fluoride Monitoring systems in
Smelter Potlines.
• Installing SO2 Analyzers at bake
Oven Stacks in the Smelter.

Handling of bulk
Hazardous Waste
• SPL
• Aluminium
Dross

• SPL carbon portion is disposed of
to an external agency authorized by
OSPCB for the utilization of its
energy value.
• Dross is recycled in-house and also
sold to authorized recyclers by OSPCB.

• Operating the existing 198 MW Wind
Power Plants and 800 KWp Rooftop
Solar installations. Additional roof-top
solar capacity of 50 Kwp already
installed at Mines.
• Project for a new 25.5 MW Wind Power
plant at Kayathar, Tamil Nadu.
• Initiatives for new rooftop solar
installations at Vizag and Damanjodi.
